deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Primary structural color — dark hero background, stat block surfaces, icon strokes, navigation wordmark, secondary button borders. A near-gray teal that reads as ink rather than ocean, so it grounds the brand without going clinical-cold

mint-pulse.$description: Mint Pulse — Primary action color — filled CTA backgrounds, badge fills, active dots, announcement bar, review star highlights. Bright green with cyan lean, makes every interactive element feel switched on and biological

soft-teal.$description: Soft Teal — Teal text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

carbon.$description: Carbon — Body text, hairline borders, icon strokes, input borders. The dominant structural neutral — most borders on the site are pure black, giving the UI a stark, editorial frame

ink.$description: Ink — Primary heading text and secondary borders. Softer than pure black for large headlines where Carbon reads as too heavy

graphite.$description: Graphite — Subhead text, button text on light surfaces, muted labels

slate.$description: Slate — Muted body text, helper copy, disabled labels, secondary icon strokes. The workhorse neutral for anything that needs to recede

fog.$description: Fog — Input borders, placeholder color, low-priority surface accents

mist.$description: Mist — Card and section dividers, subtle borders on white surfaces, separators between review cards

bone.$description: Bone — Lightest card and list surface — sits one step above pure white for subtle elevation on the page canvas

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text, input fills. The dominant light surface

inter-tight.$description: Primary brand typeface across headings, body, buttons, badges, and UI. The custom tighter cut tightens headline rhythm and gives small caps a pharmaceutical, prescription-label feel.

inter.$description: Secondary face used for stat block numerals and a few large product display sizes. Inter handles the very large gradient stats with clean digits that gradient-fill cleanly.
